text: Quest Global is an engineering services firm headquartered in Singapore. In August 2023 Carlyle agreed to acquire a 'significant minority stake' in the company, through funds managed and advised by entities affiliated with Carlyle Asia Partners; the investors Bain Capital and Advent International were to exit.
short: Quest Global is a Singapore engineering firm; Carlyle agreed to take a significant minority stake in 2023.

source.name: Quest Global: Carlyle and Quest Global Enter into a Strategic Partnership
source.quote: Carlyle will be acquiring a significant minority stake in the company. Equity for this transaction will come from funds managed and advised by entities affiliated with Carlyle Asia Partners.

additionalSources.name: Nikkei Asia (DealStreetAsia): Carlyle buys stake in Singapore's Quest Global as Bain, Advent exit
additionalSources.quote: Private equity giant Carlyle is acquiring a minority stake in Quest Global, while existing investors Bain Capital and Advent International will exit the Singapore-based engineering company.
